title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility New Arrangement Installment Clause
content:
**Calculation clause.** The monthly installment of a new arrangement on an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account is the account's patient balance divided by the arrangement term in months, rounded to the cent half up, and never less than the class's smallest monthly installment; the patient may choose a larger installment but never a smaller one. The arrangement term is the class's longest arrangement, in monthly installments, as listed for the payer class in the payment arrangement limits.

## Elements

| Element | Read from |
|---|---|
| Patient balance | the coverage account on which the arrangement is set |
| Arrangement term | the class's longest arrangement, in months |
| Floor | the class's smallest monthly installment |

## Worked figures (hypothetical balances)

**Commercial HMO account, balance 931.00** (longest arrangement 18 months, smallest installment 25.00):
931.00 divided by 18 is 51.7222…, rounded to the cent half up: 51.72. This is above 25.00, so the installment is **51.72**.

**Original Medicare Part B account, balance 931.00** (longest arrangement 12 months): 931.00 divided by 12 is 77.5833…, rounded: **77.58**.

**Original Medicare Part B account, balance 200.00**: 200.00 divided by 12 is 16.67, below the 25.00 floor, so the installment is **25.00**.

## Points of judgement

- A patient who asks to pay 90.00 a month on the 931.00 Original Medicare Part B balance may do so: a larger installment than 77.58 may be chosen.
- A patient who asks for 60.00 a month on that balance may not: the installment is never smaller than the figure the clause gives.
